releases.name: Version 1.1.0
releases.body:
- Made the mod much more functional by having it query the json files. There are no longer any fields that the user manually needs to fill in!
- Overall accounts for many more situations and is a lot more elegant.
releases.bodyZh:
- 通过查询json文件，使模组功能更强大，不再有任何需要用户手动填写的字段！
- 总体考虑了更多情况，并且更加优雅。
